law: This pointer is mutable. The INSELFACTION it names is not. A correction appends a successor archive; it never edits a predecessor. `latest_inselfaction` names only the most RECENT transmission — it does not close, supersede or rank the others. Open authority items are enumerated in `open_items`, which is the field to read before assuming nothing is pending.
channel_invariants: INV-ISX-REVIEW-RESOLVABILITY — an INSELFACTION that transfers review authority MUST expose the reviewed source through a receiver-resolvable immutable reference. If the source chamber has no accessible remote: review_status = BLOCKED_SOURCE_UNRESOLVABLE.

INV-E3-CANDIDATE-AUTHENTICITY — an adjudicator may confer E3 only when the candidate's detector event is reconstructable from its persisted source observations. Candidate metadata may identify a detection result; it may never prove one occurred.
